summary: In Mars Rover: The Red Planet Mission, you play as a rover travelling across mars. Along the way, certain rover parts break, and you have to fix them by answering questions and completing quick-time events. Depending on how well you do on the quizzes and gameplay, you get different badges. But waiting at the end of the level, there is a strange rock. What mysteries are there to oncover on this dusty red wateland?
details: Our project is a video game about a Mars rover adventuring throughout Mars, trying to keep itself intact, and unearthing new discoveries. It runs on microscript code, and teaches players how rovers work and what NASA uses them for. As of right now, the benefits of this project are to provide learning experience for our team and any others who play it, not to be an incredible, loved game. So, the intended impact is to provide for the public, but more importantly to provide for our team in the form of coding experience. We believe this project is creative because we used our collaborative effort to come up with new ideas and concepts. We used Micro Studio to code, and Claude for generating image ideas for how our project should look, and helping with the code as we are all still very new. Our team considered the information about rovers that people knew, and the stuff that was less known, trying to include as much unknown information as we could.
